note: City of Williams campground in town, between Beltrami Island State Forest and Lake of the Woods: two rows of pads beside a playground and picnic shelter. --Claude
summary: City page read: 20 full-hookup RV sites ($35 a night; $175 a week, $700 a month; tents $20), Wi-Fi, booked by phone or email. Groups moved to manual; amperage and season not stated. Note trimmed of field facts. Not waterfront kept; pin confirmed.
flags: LONG-STAY (local, for the record): the city posts weekly ($175) and monthly ($700) RV rates beside the nightly $35. Nothing suggests a seasonal-lease park: the nightly rate leads the rate list, and the Esri frame shows two RVs on about 20 pads. Google Maps 4.5 stars from 34 reviews. Read as an ordinary city campground.
Season and amperage are not on the city page; left unknown.
WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: an in-town park with no water near the pads.
PIN 48.77180,-94.95770 sits at the south end of the park, about 70 m from the pad rows (centre about 48.7724,-94.9575); Google's point 48.77175,-94.95753 agrees; confirmed (under 250 m).
PHONE 218-783-3271 confirmed (city page and Google). WEBSITE confirmed.
